hunt_curator.text: John and Gertrude Hunt were collectors and dealers. They gave everything they'd gathered to the people of Ireland: Bronze Age gold, medieval crosses, a Picasso, a Renoir, and a great deal of very small, very old things.
The building's the old Custom House, 1760s, by the river. When the ships came in, the taxman was right here. Now it's art. A big improvement in my view.

hunt_child.text: There's a tiny bronze horse in there that's about four hundred years old. I'm going to draw it. Then I'm going to the café.
